== Traveling To and From == Two options are known to exist for reaching the zone. 1. Travel from [[Evershade Weald]] to the orc section of the zone and through the false wall, click a lever on one of the lifts once you make your way to them. - This route places you within the "Lower Level" (Mostly around level 10-15) side. 2. Within the orc caves inside [[Keeper's Bight]]. == Traveling To and From == * [[Fallen Pass]] ==What's in this zone?== In [[Fallen Pass]], up the ramp from the [[Shaded Dunes]] zoneline is [[Mia Tarcut]]. She initially gives a hint for Fallen Watchs existance and works as a quest giver. If she is given a [[Hardened Ooze Pustule]] she will reward the player with [[Recipe: Cleansing Resin & Torch of Purification]] which will teach you to craft both [[Cleansing Resin]] and [[Torch of Purification]]. Just inside a zoneline is [[Marcus Aden]], a vendor that sells [[Scrivener's Satchel]], which can be used to collect page scraps, such as [[Journal Page 5 Scrap 1-5]] and [[Page 1 Scrap]]. A completed set of journal pages can be turned in to XXXXXX for recipes. For example, all page 5s for [[Recipe: Experiment X3]]. Next to [[Marcus Aden]], and also spread throughout the zone, are barrels that respond to mud commands. == Traveling To and From == [[File:Glinting hollow pinecone.png|left|400px]] To get access, one must first complete the [[Glinting Hollow Key Quest]]. From the druid portal in [[Evershade Weald]], head up the hill and into the cave guarded by the Fae Guardians, the zone in is at the lowest potion of the cave, click the pine cone under the dragons skull with your [[Glowing Fae Scale]] on your cursor.

Once inside, the area is keyed to the various locations. (Keys stay on your body through death) First Area: {{Spoiler| Kill various treants for a chance to attain [[Fresh Squirrel Meat]].
Spawn [[Softpaws]] from "Any" flat rock (Successfully spawned from two locations, one in cave at top of ramp with solo treant guarding the cave entrance and in lower cave clockwise from that ramp).
Give [[Softpaws]] a [[Fresh Squirrel Meat]] (you may have to do this while invisible because of faction hits).
From that point on, any mob on the first floor can drop [[Glinting Scale of Nature]].
[[Thornbark]] will drop 6x [[Glinting Scale of Nature]] if killed at this point.
}}
Second Area: {{Spoiler| Kill x5 [[a pale wisp]] while in the central pond water to remove the [[Toxic Fumes]] debuff (for 5 minutes), note: the debuff returns if you kill them while out of the water.
[[Brightspark]] spawns from killing [[a pale wisp]]. [[Strig]] spawns near a bush in the zone up area.
While the debuff is removed kill [[Brightspark]] or [[Strig]] for 6x [[Glinting Scale of Water]].
Killing random area trash results in a singular [[Glinting Scale of Water]].
Killing [[a glowing wisp]] will reset the Event for the area. DO NOT KILL.
}}
Third Area: {{Spoiler| Kill [[a forgotten shadow]] near one of the firepits for 6x [[Glinting Scale of Decay]]
Killing the [[a large shadow]] or [[a whispering shadow]] near a firepit may have a chance at a key as well.
}}
Fourth Area: {{Spoiler| Light the firepits around the area and disable the dot to attain keys. (requires a [[Torch]], other "torch-like" things don't seem to work, unconfirmed if this is a bug.)
CONFIRMED - There is an order to lighting the fires South-East-West-Center-North.
The center platform is missing a ramp on one side, that ramp is on the north facing side.
Use /look to read the inscriptions on each brazier.
* South - Next to a ramp between 2 Dryads and a tree. Carved into the surface is a single leaf, half-charred, half-golden. An inscription reads, 'What lingers longest is not life, but the echo of its passing.' * East - Up a ramp, over the bear cave where [[Hrask]] Spawns. The stone is ridden with ice fractures and feels brittle. An inscription reads, 'First bite of winter... sharp, sudden, and sure.' * West - Up a ramp overlooking the center platform. Carved into the stone's face is a sleeping bear coiled in ice. An inscription reads, 'Deep cold does not rage. It waits.' * Center - On the center platform. The stone is made of a stone gray slate, damp with condensation. An inscription reads, 'Between breath and silence, the veil thins.' * North - At the base of the ramp leading up to the East firepit. A hollow space in the center of the stone holds a single frozen tear. An inscription reads, 'Only when the world remembers its breath... may the heart be lit.' '''After the final brazier is lit (north); you will have 12 minutes without the DoT to get keys''' UNCONFIRMED - Kill [[Hrask]] while the dot is inactive for 6x [[Glinting Scale of Frost]].
Kill [[a snowhide bear]] while the dot is inactive for a chance at [[Glinting Scale of Frost]].
}}
Fifth Area: {{Spoiler| Hail the Drake at the center of the ruins to attain an ice pick.
Kill only non caster elementals, elementals with a mana bar will reset the process.
Once the snare is disabled, find the crack in the ice, equip the pick, right click the pick for [[Glinting Scale of Ice]]
}}
Sixth Area: {{Spoiler| Unknown, involves attaining [[Glinting Scale of Winter]]

Hail the drake at the center of the ruins to start [[Potions for Veylith Frosttongue]]
}}

== Traveling To and From == The easiest way to this zone is to take the boat that goes between [[Underdocks]] and [[Ail'Vorith]] and jump off, or get wizard port directly there. You can also follow the path of the boat first on foot along the shore and then by swimming to get there. In the [[Caves of Irem]], follow the water on the right hand side of the river from the [[Underdocks]] zone line up past the cutthroats and the Giant, then into a green lit tunnel. title: Keeper's Bight
wikitext:
__NOTOC__ [[File:Keepers Bight.png|400px|right|thumb]]
Keeper's Bight is a coastal temperate forest plateau centrally located on Aêthoril's Western Coast in the Calafrey region. Transitioning from low coastal desert in the South to high forest plateau in the North. Penshaw, under the control of the Red Mantle, provides the region port access with popular shipping routes to Zaedin's Landing and ultimately Night Harbor. To the North is Evershade Weald, to the East is Scarwood, to the South is Vale of Zintar, to the West is Shallow Shoals. The Blacktide Orcs have a dominant foothold in the South while trapping and hunting are common throughout the thick forest plateau. {{ZoneDetails |QuickLinks = [[Keeper%27s_Bight#Quests|Quests]] • [[Keeper%27s_Bight#Items|Items]] • [[Keeper%27s_Bight#NPCs|NPCs]] |Level = 5 - ?? |MonsterTypes = Wolves, Wasps, Snakes, Bears, Drakes, Basilisks, Skeletons, Will-o-wisps, Orcs, Giants |NotableNPC = [[Rarthan Wartide]], [[Belthakar Dunecaller]], [[Widow Vethra]], [[Poacher Tolan]], [[Poacher Garrus]], [[Poacher Wilna]], [[Redpaw]], [[Timberfang]], [[Brukk Goldgut]], [[Mirella Nighthorn]] |Items = - |RelatedQuests = [[Poacher's Knives]], [[Hale's Haul]], [[Left Behind]], [[Wilna's Ring]], [[Growing Threat of the Sangrel Fist]] |AdjacentZones = [[Blacktide Bay]], [[Evershade Weald]], [[Scarwood]], [[Vale of Zintar]], [[Shallow Shoals]] }}

title: Night Harbor
wikitext:
[[File:NightHarbor1.jpg|400px|thumb|right|alt=Night Harbor at Night|Night Harbor at Night]]
Night Harbor is the current main starting city for all races in the Pre-POC Era.
Night Harbor is the seat of power for the [[Langsdorfian League]], a confederacy of guilds with a near monopoly on trade and transportation throughout Aêthoril.

== Layout == The Underdocks lie inside a large circular cavern. In the middle of the cavern is an '''underground lake''', and standing in the middle of the lake is the '''Citadel''' itself -- a large building. Around the building, out over the water, runs a '''ring of stone walkway'''. The ground-level merchants stand on that '''walkway''', not inside the building. Walking it clockwise from the '''north entrance''': * A '''lift to Overreach''' stands just inside the entrance; two more lifts to Overreach also serve the walkway, for three in total. * The '''butchers' shop''' and the '''leatherworking shop''' occupy the north-east side, the leatherworking shop around the corner from the butchers. * A doorway that seems to lead into the Citadel is actually a '''teleporter pad''' and the mouth of an '''underground tunnel''' -- both lead to the '''eastern shore of the lake'''. A '''raft dock''' sits across from it. * Further on is an '''unused shop area'''. * The '''south entrance''' mirrors the north one. West of it is the '''healers' clinic''' (its second floor holds a Bind Wound trainer). * Past two more buildings, the '''south-west corner''' holds a general goods shop. * North of that: a '''small lift to Overreach''', then a second '''teleporter and tunnel''' leading to the '''west bank''', with '''docks and a ferry''' just outside on the water. * North again: '''two empty market areas''', and then, at the '''north-west corner''', a '''stair up to Forge Row''' and another '''lift to Overreach'''. The walkway closes back at the north entrance. '''The building.''' The Citadel itself is stacked, with many small floors above the walkway level: * The '''first major floor''' is an entrance hall, empty at the time of writing. * The '''second''' is '''Forge Row''' -- the smithing quarter, holding a smelting [[Forge]], an [[Anvil]], and the named blacksmith trainer, with Deltan's Smeltery alongside. * Up from the second floor is a small '''viewing area''', referred to as "floor 2.5", which leads on to floor three. * The '''third''' is the '''[[Citadel Exchange]]''' -- "like the Night Market in the harbour cities, but currently mostly empty". It holds a set of largely empty buildings, the bank (with a further lift to Overreach beside it), and the top of the '''Inn'''. The Inn doorway here is its top floor ([[Innkeeper Adrella]]); below that is the '''tavern''' ([[Barkeeper Ravik]], [[Senior Apprentice Syrsil]]), and below that the guest rooms and beds, arranged around a '''glowing tree'''. Storing bags in the bank expands your banking space. * The '''fourth''' is the '''Market Terrace''', a small open area with a mostly empty shopping area. Its only vendor is '''[[Berry]]''', who sells badly made shoes and has nothing to say. * The '''fifth''' is '''Crown Reach'''. It begins with a fancy open-faced tavern, '''[[High Note|the High Note]]''', whose snooty patrons trade Underdocks gossip while two musicians play; '''resting here grants the rested bonus'''. North of the tavern is an empty store, and north again the currently unnamed tailoring shop. Above the shop is a private residence belonging to '''[[Lady Valhassen]]''', and below it a basement theatre with a stage, seating and a bar, where she watches from the upper balcony. * '''Shortcut:''' jumping off the walkway at the entrance to Crown Reach drops you in front of the bank on the third floor. The Citadel map also shows a Crossroads Room, a Grand Terrace, a Market Terrace, a teleport, and a bath, none of which have been placed yet. == NPCs by place == Where each town NPC stands. Vale of Zintar is a coastal desert situated on the West coast of Aêthoril in the Szuur region. To the North is Keeper's Bight, to the East is Glass Flats, to the South is Fallen Watch, to the West is Shallow Shoals. Giants and Giant Undead Skeletons are the dominant force but orcs have also make their pressence known. However, corruption from unknown sources spreads in the South.
